preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only the characters '(', ')', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in result)
postconditions.description: The result string contains only the characters '(' and ')'.
The length of the result string is equal to the length of the input string s.

postconditions.expression: not any(is_correct_parenthesis_sequence(result[:i]) for i in range(1, len(result)))
postconditions.description: No strict prefix of the result string is a correct parenthesis sequence.
The result string is a correct parenthesis sequence.
